comparison.objective: Peel a cucumber while preserving both ends.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual holding/reorientation and force-bounded surface following with a swivel peeler.
comparison.success_condition: At least 44 of 48 middle patches peeled, none gouged, ends untouched, no blade-hand contact or fall, then release and stillness.
comparison.reason: Both demand bounded force and tool alignment, but peeling tests repeated curved-surface cutting rather than socket engagement and dynamic damper tuning.
